lines.zh: 我走在最前面，群狼跟在后面。
lines.en: I lead; the pack follows behind.
Eager to fight, ready for battle
Silently waiting for the right moment
Chewing on prey, enjoying the meal
Scanning the area, looking for prey

lines.zh: 打个哈欠，狼群已经在身后排开。
lines.en: One yawn, and the pack spreads out behind me.
Defending the territory, not to be invaded

lines.zh: 我数着狼群，一只也没少。
lines.en: I count the pack; not one is missing.

lines.zh: 我抬起鼻子，嗅夜里的风向。
lines.en: I lift my snout and taste the night wind.
The moon is not full yet; I lie still.

lines.zh: 我舔着前爪，把血味压下去。
lines.en: I lick my forepaw to dull the taste of blood.

lines.zh: 狼群在远处打盹，我守着。
lines.en: The pack dozes in the distance; I keep watch.

lines.zh: 我立起来，肩膀比狼高一截。
lines.en: I stand, a shoulder taller than any wolf.

lines.zh: 我名字后面的等级，你看清了吗。
lines.en: Did you read the level after my name?

lines.zh: 我的耳朵转向你藏身的方向。
lines.en: My ears turn toward where you hide.
Growling a warning, approaching the player

lines.zh: 跃起扑向玩家，展开攻击
lines.en: Jumping at the player, launching an attack
Using its gaze to intimidate the player
Advancing on the player, ready for close combat
Sniffing out the player, looking for weaknesses

lines.zh: 发出威胁叫声，警告玩家
lines.en: Releasing a threatening howl, warning the player
Locking the target, launching an attack

lines.zh: 狼群会记住你走过的路。
lines.en: The pack will remember the path you walked.

lines.zh: 别跑，狼群已经散开包围你。
lines.en: Don't run; the pack has already fanned out around you.
Your flesh is tasty, try it?

lines.zh: 你手里的生肉，让狼群躁动。
lines.en: The raw meat in your hand stirs the pack.
Bones suit my teeth better than meat.

lines.zh: 看我的爪牙撕裂你的肉。
lines.en: Watch my claws tear your flesh.

lines.zh: 我的獠牙只为猎物而生。
lines.en: My fangs are for prey only.
The pack is behind me; I lead.

lines.zh: 我的獠牙认得你的味道。
群狼在我身后，别挤过来。
lines.en: The pack is at my back. Do not crowd me.

lines.zh: 我的肩撞得你倒退三步。
lines.en: My shoulder knocks you back three steps.
The pack follows. I walk first.
Stay away, or you'll regret it.

lines.zh: 这片针叶林，狼群说了算。
lines.en: This conifer wood belongs to the pack.
Move, or I'll have to act.
Mate with me, grow the pack.

lines.zh: 首领的伴侣，要能镇住整群狼。
lines.en: The alpha's mate must hold the whole pack.
My love will be with you.

lines.zh: 我的爪子要品尝新鲜肉了！
狼群听我的嚎叫，你听见了吗。
lines.en: The pack answers my howl. Hear it?

lines.zh: 狼群看我一眼，就散开了。
lines.en: One look from me and the pack parts.
Tonight’s moon is good for hunting!

lines.zh: 整群狼跟着我，你往哪跑？
lines.en: The whole pack follows me; where will you run?

lines.zh: 我的嚎叫一落，狼群就动了。
lines.en: My howl falls, and the pack moves.

lines.zh: 你不会是我们的猎物吧？
lines.en: You won’t be our prey, right?

lines.zh: 这将是一场美丽的狩猎！
lines.en: This will be a beautiful hunt!

lines.zh: 我嗅到汗味，耳朵立起来。
lines.en: I catch the smell of sweat; my ears prick up.
Someone has walked into the hunting ground.

lines.zh: 狼群同时转头，我也转头。
lines.en: The pack turns as one; so do I.

lines.zh: 我在风里认出了你的味道。
lines.en: On the wind I recognize your scent.
The moon is bright enough to see you clearly.
One growl and the pack takes its places.
The first prey of the night.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，喉咙里起了雷。
lines.en: I lift my head and thunder gathers in my throat.
The pack taught me this bite.
The whole pack answers my howl.

lines.zh: 你的血将流在我的爪下！
lines.en: Your blood will flow under my claws!

lines.zh: 狼群的鼻息，已经在你身后。
lines.en: The pack's breath is already behind you.

lines.zh: 我从左边绕，狼群从右边。
lines.en: I circle left, the pack circles right.

lines.zh: 你后背贴着树，退不了了。
lines.en: Your back is to a tree; nowhere to retreat.
The moment I step aside, the pack lunges.
My shadow stands taller than yours.
One step back and you are in a wolf's jaws.

lines.zh: 狼群散开，我把你围在中间。
lines.en: The pack fans out and rings you.

lines.zh: 狼群跟在我后面，别回头。
lines.en: The pack follows me, do not look back.
The alpha moves first; only then the pack.
Your sword cannot stop six mouths.
Before a hunt, the quiet is deepest.
My jaws lock onto your vambrace!
I ram with my shoulder and flip you over!
Pack, on him — cut off his retreat!

lines.zh: 月圆了，我从林子里站起。
lines.en: The moon is full; I rise out of the woods.

lines.zh: 狼群散开，为我让出中间。
lines.en: The pack parts to give me the center.
I shake off the old hide.
The curse swells me a size larger.

lines.zh: 嚎声传开，狼群聚拢过来。
lines.en: My howl spreads and the pack gathers.

lines.zh: 我用后腿站起来，比人高。
lines.en: I rise on my hind legs, taller than a man.

lines.zh: 夜风把血腥味送到我鼻端。
lines.en: The night wind brings blood to my nose.
The alpha is here; make way.

lines.zh: 森林的呼吸，跟着我的脚步。
lines.en: The forest breathes in time with my steps.
I step from the trees, eyes glowing first.

lines.zh: 狼群的嚎叫在水下闷住了。
lines.en: The pack's howl is muffled underwater.
The arrow lodges shallow in my fur.

lines.zh: 连狼嚎都传不进这片虚空。
lines.en: Not even a howl carries into this void.
